In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social presence of virtual characters can be designed and controlled by matching the personality of virtual characters to the personality of human users.
the personality of synthesized voices and textual content should be matched to user personality to maximize users' sense of social presence.

the more a user's social personality matches with the social personality of the artificial representation of the computer system (i.e., the computer agent), the stronger the sense of social presence the user would feel.

the social presence of a social actor is a function of the user and the social actor's personality, and that the social presence is enhanced when the user's and the social actor’s personalities are similar.
